import os
import time


def write_log(content, level="INFO", log_dir="./log"):
    """Write a timestamped log entry to a monthly log file."""
    date_str = time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', time.localtime(time.time()))
    update_log = f"[{date_str}] [{level}] {content}\n"
    print(update_log)

    os.makedirs(log_dir, exist_ok=True)
    log_file = os.path.join(log_dir, f"{time.strftime('%Y-%m', time.localtime(time.time()))}-update.log")
    with open(log_file, 'a', encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(update_log)
